interface.longDescription: Inspect sites, staging environments, backups, PHP versions, logs, performance, plugins and themes. Prepare and explicitly confirm hosting changes with expiring, single-use previews. Uses Pressable official MCP, Windows DPAPI locally and an always-on Ubuntu adapter with encrypted credentials for private ChatGPT access. Independent Rizonetech integration; not endorsed by Pressable. Includes reviewed WP-CLI media import, content and footer updates, plus job-status and output reads. Commands require exact previews; submission is asynchronous and does not prove completion.
defaultPrompt: List my Pressable sites and identify production and staging environments.
Review hosting health, PHP versions and plugin security alerts.
Prepare a cache purge for a specific site and show me the preview.

description: Manage Pressable hosting and reviewed WP-CLI commands, with encrypted credentials, explicit change previews and asynchronous result checks.
name: pressable
